name: quirk-linter
goal: Zero-token checks for mistakes a model is known to make, run before the gates: re-indented verbatim text (Nemotron, 29 lines in one real attempt) and forced failures hidden inside try blocks (a test-writing habit). Also the calibration run for the two new members: Barry on GLM-5.3-Flash and Gordon on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. The fix must change ONLY the leading spaces inside a drifting string literal - everything else in the source, including the quotes and a trailing backslash-n, stays byte for byte. Build the key map once and use it in both functions.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover the placeholder rule from both sides ({css} is a placeholder, '{ type' with a space is not), a literal ending in backslash-n, two drifted literals on one line, idempotence of the fix, and a source with no drift returned unchanged with 0.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row for both languages. For Python the rule is about the NEAREST less-indented line only; for JavaScript track brace depth and which depths are open try blocks.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, a nested if inside a try (Python: not reported; JavaScript: reported), a fail in a catch block (not reported), a one-line try, and the ValueError for an unknown language.
